# SondeHub+ Local

> Local Python web dashboard and HTTP API for radiosonde monitoring using SondeHub, optional Radiosonde Watch, and optional local radiosonde_auto_rx logs.

## Canonical repository

- Repository: https://github.com/tomaszspica-dot/SondeHub-Plus-Local
- README: https://github.com/tomaszspica-dot/SondeHub-Plus-Local/blob/main/README.md
- Agent instructions: https://github.com/tomaszspica-dot/SondeHub-Plus-Local/blob/main/AGENTS.md
- Configuration example: https://github.com/tomaszspica-dot/SondeHub-Plus-Local/blob/main/.env.example
- Installer: https://github.com/tomaszspica-dot/SondeHub-Plus-Local/blob/main/install.sh
- systemd template: https://github.com/tomaszspica-dot/SondeHub-Plus-Local/blob/main/systemd/sondehub-plus.service.example
- Third-party notices: https://github.com/tomaszspica-dot/SondeHub-Plus-Local/blob/main/THIRD_PARTY.md

## Main capabilities

- Browser dashboard for local radiosonde monitoring.
- SondeHub current, historical, listener, launch-site, recovery, and amateur-data integration.
- Optional Radiosonde Watch integration.
- Optional local radiosonde_auto_rx log integration.
- Realtime telemetry status.
- Local reception and station analytics.
- Local HTTP/JSON API.

## Important API entry points

- /
- /healthz
- /api/status
- /api/sondes
- /api/sonde?serial=...
- /api/realtime?serial=...
- /api/local-receptions
- /api/local-receptions-7d
- /api/local-receptions-all
- /api/local-flight?serial=...
- /api/station-stats-7d
- /api/sites?distance_km=...
- /api/listeners?distance_km=...
- /api/recovery-stats?distance_km=...

## Agent rules

Read AGENTS.md before editing.

Do not invent installation-specific callsigns, hostnames, local endpoint paths, credentials, or absolute home paths.

Keep the example bind address local-only by default.

Preserve the inline-script callsign escaping in render_page().

Run ./install.sh --check and git diff --check after changes.
